notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
🍬 Hey Players! 🍬

We’ve just rolled out a new update for Candy Shop Simulator and we’ve packed in some tweaks, fixes and cool new tools to make your candy–making life easier (and tastier 😋). Here’s what’s new:

✨ Patch Notes:

 Slight optimization improvements for smoother gameplay
 Improved 3rd person camera – now placed more to the side so it won’t block your view
 Added a crosshair for better precision
 Added new help tips to guide you along the way
 Fixed the serving plate (no more funky behavior there 🍽️)
 Introduced the Duplicator – it can duplicate your creations (not only the final ones!)
 Added an Advanced Mixer that automatically pulls ingredients straight from your pantry 🥣
 Product prices are now calculated based on the ingredients you used
 Looking at a shelf or product display now shows you the quantity available
 Cooling & baking times reduced to just 5 seconds ⏱️
 Hand mixer now works without you having to stir manually 🎉


We hope these changes make your candy shop a smoother, sweeter experience. Thanks for all your feedback! It really helps us shape the game! 💌

See you soon,
Candy Shop Simulator Team 🍬

notes.title: Take Your Sweet Time!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 👋

I know you are hungry for some sweets, and we deliver! 🛵
In this devlog we're gonna be talking about something completely new and exciting!
Candy Shop Simulator is not only a game about making beautiful and tasty creations, but also about running a business. So here we go with another mechanic! 🎂

Order System
After reaching a certain level of your shop, you will unlock the Order mechanic.
Through your phone  you will be able to see specific cake orders made by interested customers, which you can accept or deny! 📱
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/f3b7b98b5ed77bfef821ed6d3c304e347eb0d3eb.png

After accepting the order, you will have to make the cake according to the specific layers, toppings and decorations, and then deliver it to the client on your bicycle! If you fail, you lose reputation and money. 🚲
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/bccd2ebec1321843aa6d90146588f82bec8421ef.png

I know, a time limit sounds terrifying, but you can ease up. It isn't anything close to a speed race, you will have enough time to plan the cake, and even go out to buy the ingredients for it. Some of the requests may be very specific, we don't require you to have everything in the stock right away! 🕰️
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/d8b23e4cd5351df7bf711aff00c88791ac75fd15.png

Why do the orders in the first place?

 It brings more money than average sales in your shop! 
 New exciting challenges with time management!
 You can feel like a true confectioner with a mission!
 It will require of you much more flexibility and moving around then just sitting at the shop all day long!


Freedom of creation![/h3]
I understand that orders may sound a bit too restrictive. But that is not true at all. You can choose the style of decorations and how you make it, the order you put on the ingredients is up to you.
Orders aren't here to restrict, but to give you a push towards a certain objective. How you reach it is up to you! 😍

Our team had some fun with their own cake creation, showing off what can be done in Candy Shop Simulator. Check out their orders! 👇
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/bca8c8fa1d849bd4755881b4959e3177a1a4c34b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/d09f3b8f50fffa326f3cc4e6cdd00980ba3a528a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/61c49544a342708577407ba9ad02e40f7345ccbc.png

That is it for now, I hope you are excited as much as we are about creating some cakes! If you want to share your feedback, thoughts, crazy sweet ideas, feel free to join our Discord server! 💬
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/6338a0ceb937b950614e717143ae674efd0a8c59.png

See you soon!
Candy Shop Simulator Team

notes.title: Additional Furniture
notes.content:
Hello Candymakers! 🍬

We’re excited to introduce new gameplay features to make your Candy Shop Simulator experience even sweeter! Get ready for more interaction, fun and challenges as you manage your candy shop. 💪

We’ve decided to add additional features to make your candy shop management experience more engaging. Now, when customers purchase a cake in your shop, they will either leave or (if the player buys and places tables) sit at the tables and enjoy their dessert. Having customers eat at your tables will always give a positive boost to your shop's overall rating. 😋

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/9cd29a79d503b8652b344a34d174d04651ba18f1.png
Cleaning and Customer Satisfaction 🧼
Customers in your shop aren’t the cleanest, and they won’t clean up after themselves. Therefore, you or an employed staff member will need to clean up the tables by clicking on them. If there are dirty plates on a table, customers won’t sit at it, so keeping your tables tidy is crucial for maintaining a steady flow of customers. 🧹

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/8cbdc0a2334fb5508e714a1224eb6430071aa6a3.png
Customization Options for Your Shop 🎨
In addition to the gameplay changes, we’ve also added a customization feature! You can paint tables, tablecloths, and chairs separately, allowing you to create a truly personalized and visually appealing space for your customers. 🌈

Get ready to manage your candy shop with even more going on and if you’d like to stay on top of any upcoming news don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist and join our discord to get notified about any updates! 👍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/6338a0ceb937b950614e717143ae674efd0a8c59.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2811530/Candy_Shop_Simulator/

See you soon
Candy Shop Simulator Team

 Shorter & optimized tutorial – Product purchases have been streamlined, and some steps and text have been removed for a faster experience.  
 Fixed product ordering in tutorial – No more getting stuck due to a lack of money when ordering products.  
 Building mode improvement – Trees will now disappear when the camera gets too close.

 Faster deliveries – The delivery truck now arrives quicker, so you can restock even faster! 🚛💨  



We also recently added a new **in-game bug report window**, making it easier for you to send us any issues you find. We really appreciate your feedback, so don’t hesitate to use it! 🛠️

notes.title: Cake making process
notes.content:
Hello Confectioners! 👋

We’re happy to see you again in our kitchen. Today we’d like to share with you our carefully prepared procedure of making delicious cakes! 🎂 You can use it in your future shops so better pay close attention and without further ado, let’s get going!

1. Purchasing Ingredients 🛒
First, we begin the culinary journey by visiting the in-game store to purchase essential baking ingredients. The store offers a variety of items as we’ve already mentioned in the previous devlog! 😉

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/349f27459451ed9bc44132c606813bd21617be3a.png
2. Mixing the Ingredients 🥣
Once the ingredients are acquired, we have to proceed to the kitchen to mix them and create a beautiful base for further steps.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/42eb41ba06c64d0cee774d6a8baa5285040f49a5.png
3. Baking the Cake Layers 🌡️
You can choose the shape and flavor of the cake layers. Available options include flavors like vanilla and chocolate 🍫

Successful baking results in mouth-watering cake layers which are bound to charm your future customers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/de4e22f7a9570fce75dd17a7692a0cd1c5834ad4.png
4. Preparing the Frosting 🍯
Dry cake isn’t enough to impress anyone so to add a little charm and personal touch you should also create your own icings with customizable color and flavors! 🤤

The frosting adds both flavor and visual appeal to the cake. Another important feature of a perfect cake! 🍰

5. Decorating with Fruits and Other Toppings 🍓
Decoration allows for even more creativity. Use the most amazing fruits you’ve collected (we’ve mentioned some good places to look for them in the previous devlog) and pair them with other decorations to push your creation to the next level. 💪

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/d2b5e42feb7fa90e92a0c11e7ec84ab54f7c8c24.png
6. Selling or Delivering the Cake 💲
Once the cake is complete, you have two options:
Display for sale: Place the cake on display in your store
Deliver to a client: Fulfill specific customer orders, ensuring timely and safe delivery

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/b8060763f1dd5edbca1b1c2327b6b14e28004cc8.png
We can’t wait to hear your thoughts on the baking process. If you have any suggestions or opinions on this topic please let us know in the comments under the devlog, in the discussion section or on our discord! We’ll be looking forward to hearing from all of you! ❤️‍

notes.title: Ingredients
notes.content:
Dear Confectioners!

We’re happy to see you again in our shop. Today we’d like to talk about another crucial mechanic you can use to stay ahead of the competition. We know that only the top quality ingredients can make for a top quality sweets therefore ingredients will be the topic of today’s devlog! 🤩

In our game there are two ways you can use to acquire them through shopping or gathering. Let’s take a closer look at both of them to have a better understanding of the opportunities they present you with. 👀

Shopping 🛒
Nothing beats the good old market when it comes to availability and quantity. Eggs, sugar, flour- everything you need in large quantities you can find there. Market will undoubtedly become a perfect place while making sure that all of the everyday necessities find their way to your storage. 📝

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/0a06391a540d7ffd397c370b2c6a31013f3e401c.png
Gathering 🌱
The forests outside the town are home to many amazing plants. Juicy berries, apples and other kinds of mouth-watering fruits wait for you to pick them up. Handpick the best of what forest has in store to create the highest quality pastries. We’ve heard that some other ingredients can be found there as well. 🍎 While time-consuming, this is the best way to raise the happiness of your customers. 👍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/92663a9c764a5527884375ef1ca75868310b5bb4.png
The key to success lies in the ability to bring out the best of both sources while maintaining a good balance between all the activities required to operate your candy shop. ⌚

What do you think about this part of the gameplay? We’d love to hear your opinions on this topic so make sure to leave a comment below 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2811530/Candy_Shop_Simulator/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/6338a0ceb937b950614e717143ae674efd0a8c59.png

Stay sweet and see you soon!! 🍬
Candy Shop Simulator Team

notes.title: Sweets workshop 🍬
notes.content:
Greetings from our Candy Shop! 👋

We’re happy to see you again in the third devlog from our candy workshop. Today we’d like to briefly introduce you to one of the core mechanics of the entire gameplay- creating your own amazing sweets. 🍬

The sweets you’ll create can be sold in your shop, or delivered to the customers’ houses if they order them that way. The deliveries are done with the bike, as we’ve mentioned in the previous devlogs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/efa1f0f6876d6bb87c866b331dfb1b9fb3be1881.png

Your workshop contains many amazing devices so it’s ready for your work. You’ll be able to create many mouth watering creations such as cakes, lollipops, donuts, cupcakes and ice cream. 🤤

Our main goal is to give you as much freedom of creation as we can. 💪 That’s why you’ll be able to alter the colors, shapes and decorations of your products! If you want to get involved in the process and look for a game that gives you a lot of freedom of artistic expression, this is the place for you! 🔥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/f213f6736ff92bc515caa60d6365779a14bb59f8.png

🍦 There are lots of activities to choose from such as creating cakes, baking and decorating them. Create ice cream mixtures, sugar syrup and lollipops using your own design or a pre-existing one. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/169e82e72e7e13e1715298055d813d0e84cf254d.png

We’ve got a question for you. Which topics would you like us to cover in the future? Let us know in the comments! 👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/6338a0ceb937b950614e717143ae674efd0a8c59.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2811530/Candy_Shop_Simulator/

See you soon,
Candy Shop Simulator Team

notes.title: Character Customization
notes.content:
Hello Candy Makers! 👋

Welcome back to devlog#2 of 🍬 Candy Shop Simulator! Today we’ve prepared a cool feature for you to check out! 

In our game there’ll be an option to customize your character. It’s not going to be anything complex but you’ll get to make choices on the following elements:

- gender
- skin color
- eye color
- head shape
- hair
- clothes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/1ecdf75a870f30cd3a5a03b8f83daab204e31f75.png
We wanted to give you some way to make your character more personalized to allow you to further immerse yourself in the candy shop experience! 💪

On top of that, we do understand that the looks can get boring and you might want to mix things up a little. That’s why we’ve introduced ways to change your appearance during the gameplay! 🤩 With the help of shops in your city (That you can visit with the previously mentioned bike 🚲) you can change your character to some degree.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/50865ec948488aaa477b4957293e73ae1e51140f.png
These shops are the hairdresser and the clothing store. 👕 Although you can’t change your eye color or the shape of your head, it is only natural to change your style once in a while, isn’t it?

What would you like us to talk about in the next devlog? 🤔 Let us know in the comments! Thank you for joining us today. If you enjoyed the devlog consider joining our discord and adding the game to your wishlist to get notified about the upcoming news!

See you soon,
Candy Shop Simulator Team

notes.title: 🍭 Welcome to the Candy Shop 🍭
notes.content:
Hello Candy Lovers! 🍬

Welcome to the first devlog from most likely the most sugar-packed game on Steam! 🤤 We’re happy to see you’re interested in our game and today we’d like to outline the ideas for the gameplay. As you may have guessed, it is another game in the “Pet Shop” universe! ❤️ If you’re not familiar with the title, you may want to check it out in the link below! 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2401680/Pet_Shop_Simulator/ 
As the name suggests, you’ll become an owner of your own candy shop! 🍭 Your assortment will consist of both sweets ordered from other producers and the ones you’ll produce. We’re sure you’ll be interested in hearing more about this mechanic that’s why we’ll create a separate devlog all about making sweets! 🍫

You’ll also get to experience other everyday activities necessary for smooth operation of your store- selling products at checkout, restocking the shelves etc. 

We’ll also introduce a bike delivery mechanic. 🚲 You’ll be able to deliver the sweets from your shop to your customers’ doorsteps using a cool bike. The ordered sweets will mostly consist of hand made cakes and cupcakes. 🧁 This part of the city is bike-friendly and there are almost no cars in there. (With an exception for the delivery trucks with all the necessary supplies for your store). On top of that, the bike will undoubtedly help you to arrive at many service points such as hairdresser. ✂️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/7269ed2e367201c94de4f0bc40df65efa452c804.png
Be careful though, there is a deadline for delivery and missing it will make the client drop a negative review for your shop, not to mention revoking the order. 🙁

This brings us to today’s question: Would you like to be able to have some customization options for your bikes? Let us know in the comments! 💬

There’s one more interesting feature available in the game- the building where your shop is placed…🔨 You’ll be the one to create it! This will allow you to plan the inside of your store and adjust it so it accommodates your gameplay tactic the best! With that being said, it is another big mechanic which most definitely deserves a separate devlog so we’ll make sure to talk about it in more detail on another occasion. 💪

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/e1334f915289a8ec1c6a68b63a220fbf4af19caf.png
This brings us to an end of today’s devlog- we can’t wait to hear from you so make sure to drop a comment in the discussion section! If you’d like to be an active part in creating our game we suggest adding the game to your wishlists on Steam so you don’t miss out on any Playtest, devlog and important notifications we’ll publish! 👍 You can also join our discord community and have a chat with our crew. 🙂

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/6338a0ceb937b950614e717143ae674efd0a8c59.png
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2811530/Candy_Shop_Simulator/ 

See you soon,
Candy Shop Simulator Team
